'''Étienne Klein''' ({{IPA|fr|klɛ̃|lang}}; born 1958) is a French [[physicist]] and [[philosopher of science]]. A graduate of [[École Centrale Paris]], he holds a DEA ([[Master of Advanced Studies]]) in [[theoretical physics]]. In June 2026, [[Paris Cité University|Université Paris Cité]] revoked his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in philosophy due to extensive plagiarism in his dissertation.

==Profile==
Étienne Klein is a Research director at the [[Commissariat à l'énergie atomique et aux énergies alternatives|Commissariat à l'énergie atomique et aux énergies alternatives (CEA)]].<ref name="A">[http://www-centre-saclay.cea.fr/en/Klein Centre Saclay CEA]</ref> He is currently head of the Laboratoire des Recherches sur les Sciences de la Matière (LARSIM), a research laboratory belonging to the CEA and located in [[Saclay]] near Paris.<ref>[https://iramis.cea.fr/Phocea/Vie_des_labos/Ast/ast_groupe.php?id_groupe=748 Laboratoire des Recherches sur les Sciences de la Matière (LARSIM)]</ref> He took part in several major projects, such as the adjustment of a [[Isotopic separation#Laser|method of isotopic separation]] involving the use of lasers, and the study of a [[particle accelerator]] with superconducting cavities. At [[CERN]] he was involved in the design of the [[Large Hadron Collider]] (LHC).<ref name="Futura">[http://www.futura-sciences.com/fr/comprendre/carte-blanche/scientifique/t/matiere/d/klein_101/ « Carte blanche à Étienne Klein », Futura-Sciences]</ref>

He taught [[quantum physics]] and [[particle physics]] at Centrale Paris for several years and currently teaches philosophy of science.<ref>[http://www.ecp.fr/home/actualite?actuID=35242 « Cours d'Étienne Klein en vidéo »]</ref> He is a specialist in the question of time in physics and has written a number of essays on the subject. He is also a member of the [[:fr:Conseil d'analyse de la société|Conseil d'analyse de la société]], of the conseil scientifique de la [[Cité des Sciences et de l'Industrie|Cité des Sciences]], of the Conseil de l'[[Parliamentary Office for the Evaluation of Scientific and Technological Choices|Office parlementaire d'évaluation des choix scientifiques et technologiques]] (OPECST), of the [[French Academy of Technologies]] and of the Conseil d'Orientation de l'[[:fr:Institut Diderot|Institut Diderot]].<ref name="A" /> Every Thursday morning he presents a radio chronicle, ''Le Monde selon Étienne Klein'', as well as ''La Conversation scientifique'' every Saturday afternoon, on the French public station [[France Culture]].<ref>[http://www.franceculture.fr/podcast/4488591 « Le Monde selon Étienne Klein, 2012-2013 »]</ref><ref>{{Cite web | url=http://www.franceculture.fr/emissions/la-conversation-scientifique | title=La Conversation scientifique : Podcast et réécoute sur France Culture| date=5 November 2017}}</ref>

Étienne Klein practises mountain-climbing<ref>[http://www.universcience.tv/video-etienne-klein-libido-sciendi-569.html « Étienne Klein, libido sciendi, Portrait d'Étienne Klein diffusé sur universcience.tv du 22/01 au 25/02/2010.. »]</ref> and other endurance sports.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ultratrailmb.com/page/107/Resultats.html |title=Résultats de l'Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc (cherchez Klein et non pas Étienne Klein) |access-date=2013-08-04 |archive-date=2015-03-20 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150320021328/http://ultratrailmb.com/page/107/Resultats.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>

== Plagiarism affairs ==
In December 2016, ''Science'' magazine, a publication of the  [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]],  reported that Étienne Klein was responsible for plagiarizing the novelist [[Stefan Zweig]] and other authors.<ref>{{Cite web | url=https://www.science.org/content/article/popular-french-physicist-accused-plagiarizing-colleagues-and-famous-writers | title=Popular French physicist accused of plagiarizing colleagues and famous writers| date=2016-12-07}}</ref>

In August 2024, French media [[Arrêt sur images]] revealed that  88 of the 429 pages of the book adapted from his PhD thesis, ''L’Unité de la physique'' (2000), contain plagiarized text by [[Gerald Holton]], [[Lambros Couloubaritsis]] and other philosophers.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.arretsurimages.net/articles/etienne-klein-une-these-constellee-de-plagiats |title=Étienne Klein, une thèse constellée de plagiats |date=2024-08-05 |website=[[Arrêt sur images]] |last1=Guémart |first1=Loris |last2=Abbiateci |first2=Jean}}</ref> After an investigation that lasted 20 months, the [[Paris Cité University|Université Paris Cité]] found Klein to have massively plagiarized in his thesis, leading to them stripping his doctorate degree and barring him from re-registering for obtaining a PhD.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2026-06-12 |title=Le physicien Etienne Klein sanctionné par son université pour plagiats |url=https://www.lemonde.fr/sciences/article/2026/06/12/le-physicien-etienne-klein-sanctionne-par-son-universite-pour-plagiats_6701143_1650684.html |access-date=2026-06-13 |language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Guémart |first=Loris |last2=Abbiateci |first2=Jean |date=2026-06-11 |title=Thèse plagiée : Étienne Klein perd son doctorat |url=https://www.arretsurimages.net/articles/these-plagiee-etienne-klein-perd-son-doctorat |access-date=2026-06-13 |website=www.arretsurimages.net |language=fr}}</ref>

==Chorizo tweet==

On July 22, 2022, Klein tweeted a photo that he presented as an image of [[Proxima Centauri]], the closest star to the [[Solar System]], taken by the [[James Webb Space Telescope]]. A few days later, he revealed that the photo was actually of a slice of [[chorizo]] against a black background. He described his tweet as a "form of amusement" and urged his 92,000 Twitter followers to "be wary of arguments from authority".<ref>{{cite news | last =Alund| first =Natalie Neysa| title =Spanish meat or space star? Scientist's tweet shot of 'distant star' is actually slice of chorizo | newspaper =[[USA Today]]| location = | pages = | language = | publisher = | date =August 5, 2022 | url =https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2022/08/05/scientist-james-webb-space-telescope-photo-chorizo/10248521002/| accessdate =August 6, 2022 }}</ref> Klein posted the photo a day after [[Peter Coles]] posted the same photo as a joke about JWST observations.<ref>{{cite web |title=ChorizoGate: an Accidental Hoax |url=https://telescoper.blog/2022/08/03/chorizogate-an-accidental-hoax/ |website=In the Dark |access-date=12 June 2026 |language=en |date=3 August 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=What's the French for Schadenfreude? |url=https://telescoper.blog/2026/06/12/whats-the-french-for-schadenfreude/ |website=In the Dark |access-date=12 June 2026 |language=en |date=12 June 2026}}</ref>

== Distinctions and awards ==
* [[Ordre des Palmes académiques|Officier dans l’Ordre des Palmes académiques]]
* Award for the best scientific book of the year 1993 in Germany for ''Conversations avec le Sphinx, les paradoxes en physique''
* Prix Jean Perrin for popularizing science from the [[:fr:Société française de physique|Société française de physique]] in 1997<ref>[http://sfp.in2p3.fr/Prix/prix.html#perrin Les prix de la SFP]</ref> 
* Grammaticakis-Neumann Award from the [[Académie des sciences (France)|Académie des sciences]] in 2000
* Award for the best book of scientific literature of the year for ''L’Atome au pied du mur et autres nouvelles''
* Prix Budget from the [[Académie des sciences morales et politiques]] in 2000
* Prix « La science se livre » 2003 for ''Les Tactiques de [[Chronos]]''
* Prix Jean Rostand in 2004
* Prix Thorel for ''Galilée et les Indiens. Allons-nous liquider la science ?'' in 2008
* [[Ordre national de la Légion d'honneur|Chevalier de la Légion d’honneur]], promotion du 1er janvier 2010
* Prix Thorel from the [[Académie des sciences morales et politiques]] in 2010
